scope: Native practical browser interaction assumptions only; no runtime changes

edits.name: Respect native View closing at practical start and reopen Accessibility
edits.old:
await start.focus(); await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); const active = await state(page); expect(active.practicalMode).toBe(true); expect(active.quizMode).toBe(true); expect(active.labelMode).toBe('hidden');
  await expect(button(page, 'Organ name labels hidden during assessment')).toBeDisabled();

edits.name: Reopen Study through the native route before ending the practical
edits.old:
await chooser(page).screenshot({ path: `${out}/native-practical-view.png`, style: screenshotStyle });
  await study.getByRole('button', { name: 'End timed practical', exact: true }).click();

edits.name: Reopen restored View through its native toggle after End
edits.old:
await study.getByRole('button', { name: 'End timed practical', exact: true }).click(); const ended = await state(page); expect(ended.practicalMode).toBe(false); expect(ended.quizMode).toBe(false); expect(ended.labelMode).toBe('show');
  await expect(chooser(page).locator('[data-diss-view-subgroup]')).toHaveCount(4);
